renders.comment: The pane owns the console (it is docked to the right of the conversation), so the console markers are checked HERE. With the pane on screen the route renders the short status card instead of a second frame — one console, one view.

The pane-hidden branch: the app kept the pane's zone minimized, so the page renders the console itself AND says why, with the way out in reach. Without this check the fallback could regress to a silent console and nothing would notice.
